title: Prompt Injection Defense for Banking AI Agents: Threat Model, Controls, and a Red-Team Cadence
summary: Prompt injection is the highest-impact attack against an AI agent in a bank because the agent has tools that move money. The threat model, the architectural controls, and the red-team patterns we exercise before every deployment.
